description: Figure 5b, titled “P6: Matching statistics,” is a pie chart that visualizes the distribution of matching frequencies between Persona 6 (P6) and the other six personas (P1 through P7), based on the number of questions for which they share identical answers. The chart is divided into seven segments, each representing a different match count, ranging from 0 to 6 matches. The largest segment, colored light blue, corresponds to 6 matches (27.2%, 8006 questions), indicating the highest frequency of perfect agreement between P6 and another persona. The second-largest segment, in light green, represents 2 matches (22.4%, 6583 questions). Other segments include 1 match (13.8%, 4046 questions, light yellow), 0 matches (13.3%, 3910 questions, light gray), 5 matches (10.4%, 3043 questions, medium blue), 4 matches (6.2%, 1810 questions, medium green), and 3 matches (6.8%, 2002 questions, light olive). The chart uses distinct colors for each segment and labels each slice with its percentage and absolute count, providing a clear breakdown of how often P6’s preferences align with those of the other personas across different levels of agreement.
